features: Acceleration vs shear-turbulence straining marks converging acceleration and diverging APG deceleration in bump and CD channel non-equilibrium.
Baseline anisotropic stress magnitude vs k marks strong shear layers where SST stress shape error is largest to scale correction.
Signed flow-pressure alignment ~cos(U,gradp): >0 APG deceleration/separation lee side, <0 FPG acceleration crest, magnitude-independent for bump flows.
Turbulent length vs wall distance: ~0 near-wall attached, ~1 free-shear wake/separation bubble to separate near-wall vs outer SST error.
Bounded non-equilibrium excess: 0 at Pk=eps equilibrium, +1 excess production in separation shear, -1 decay in wake where SST anisotropy fails.

proposal.risk_audit: Checked dimensionless: Pk/eps [L2/T3]/[L2/T3]=1, UgradP/eps same=1, sqrt(k)/(omega*d) [L/T]/[(1/T)*L]=1. Finiteness: eps>0 interior and UgradP,Pk finite so first two finite except possible freestream eps~0 (<1% points); wall feature needs d>0,omega>0 which holds for cell-centers, goes to 0 at wall not inf. Avoided Snorm/Wnorm-only ratios because derivable from I1/I2 and redundant; chosen features use new primitives eps,Pk,UgradP,d. Risk: Pk/eps and UgradP/eps share denominator so partly correlated but numerators order differently (shear vs pressure work); large freestream values are tamed by x/(|x|+median|x|) mapping.

features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Production-to-dissipation ratio marks non-equilibrium turbulence where equilibrium SST under/over-predicts separation and shear.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed pressure work vs dissipation, >0 adverse, locates APG deceleration and separation onset where SST fails.

features.name: f_wall
features.rationale: Turbulent-to-wall length ratio distinguishes near-wall vs free-shear, letting search blend correction off in wake.

proposal.risk_audit: All three verified dimensionless (1/T vs 1/T, L^3/T^3 vs L^3/T^3, L^2/T^3 vs L^2/T^3); finite off-wall: f_curv denom Wnorm+Snorm+omega>0 always, f_apgd/f_advk use k*Umag>0 and eps>0 like accepted f_wall/f_apg so >99% finite; orderings distinct from I1,I2,f_wall,f_noneq (curvature vs wall-scaled APG vs advection) to avoid collinearity; median-normalization limits extreme-value overfit; retain f_wall/f_noneq despite <=0 gain as noisy early estimate, drop f_apg as superseded by wall-scaled f_apgd to target worst heldout bump_h26 separation-curvature-APG.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Rotation-minus-strain marks curvature: positive in rotation-dominated separation wake, negative in strain-dominated acceleration where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_apgd
features.rationale: Wall-scaled signed pressure work, >0 APG deceleration/separation onset and <0 FPG acceleration, weights near-wall vs outer for bump flows.

features.name: f_advk
features.rationale: Signed k-advection vs dissipation marks transport-driven non-equilibrium in separation shear and reattachment where local-equilibrium SST fails.

proposal.risk_audit: All three checked dimensionless under velocity*2 length*3 scaling; bounded 0-1 forms finite except exact wall/stagnation 0/0 expected <1% points; ordering distinct from I1/I2 and active APG/curv/non-eq features; drop f_wall/f_advk which have negative heldout_gain and cause overfit, keep unused zero-gain features for diversity.

features.name: f_ti
features.rationale: Turbulence intensity high in separation bubble/wake and low in accelerating core, marks bump separation vs FPG acceleration where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_acc
features.rationale: Acceleration vs shear-turbulence straining marks converging acceleration and diverging APG deceleration in bump and CD channel non-equilibrium.

features.name: f_anis
features.rationale: Baseline anisotropic stress magnitude vs k marks strong shear layers where SST stress shape error is largest to scale correction.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed ratios use numerator/denominator of identical kinematic units so invariant under velocity x2 / length x3; denominators are sums of non-negative same-unit scales +eps or +sqrt(k) so finite except exact wall 0/0 on <1% points, non-constant ordering; they replace unbounded/singular f_noneq/f_apgd/f_ti and unused f_curv with bounded [-1,1]/[0,1] variants to avoid median-mapping saturation, target worst heldout bump_h26/h38 APG separation/curvature/wake vs FPG acceleration, retain useful f_acc/f_anis to limit overfit and redundancy with I1/I2.

features.name: f_pgalign
features.rationale: Signed flow-pressure alignment ~cos(U,gradp): >0 APG deceleration/separation lee side, <0 FPG acceleration crest, magnitude-independent for bump flows.

features.name: f_wall
features.rationale: Turbulent length vs wall distance: ~0 near-wall attached, ~1 free-shear wake/separation bubble to separate near-wall vs outer SST error.

features.name: f_prodex
features.rationale: Bounded non-equilibrium excess: 0 at Pk=eps equilibrium, +1 excess production in separation shear, -1 decay in wake where SST anisotropy fails.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed features are dimensionless under U->2U, L->3L (1/T over 1/T; L^2/T^3 over L^2/T^3). Finite: f_curv and f_shear have omega>0 denominator => 100% finite; f_apgstr 0/0 only at wall/stagnation where Umag=0 and UgradP=0 (<1% points, like accepted f_acc). No log/exp blowup, no sqrt-negative. Ordering distinct from f_acc/f_anis/f_wall: curvature sign, signed APG strength vs cos-only f_pgalign, timescale vs equilibrium-ratio f_prodex. Risk of correlation with f_acc mitigated by dropping unused f_pgalign/f_prodex; new forms add magnitude information missing in cos-only version. Node cost low, bounded forms prevent outliers.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Rotation-vs-strain excess marks curved shear and rotation-dominated bubble core vs strain-dominated attached layer where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_apgstr
features.rationale: Signed APG strength relative to inertial straining: +1 strong APG deceleration/separation lee side, -1 strong FPG acceleration crest for bumps and CD channel.

features.name: f_shear
features.rationale: Mean-shear vs turbulence frequency marks high-shear non-equilibrium separation shear where SST eddy viscosity overpredicts.
